items.title: 美國食藥署（FDA）駁回Capricor Therapeutics治療杜氏肌肉失養症的細胞療法，這項決定早有預兆
items.summary: 美國食藥署（FDA）宣布駁回Capricor Therapeutics開發、用於治療杜氏肌肉失養症患者的細胞療法。

items.title: STAT+: Is MAHA’s think tank in the tank? Tax filings show low reserves
items.summary: Tax filings show the MAHA Institute spent more than $1 million in 2025, ending its first year with just $171,000 as events and overhead drained its cash.

items.title: STAT+: UnitedHealth sues to reverse downgraded Medicare Advantage quality scores
items.summary: UnitedHealth Group joined the ranks of insurers that have sued the federal government over lowered Medicare Advantage ratings, with billions at stake.

items.title: Celldex drug stumbles in eczema; Epigenetic editing startup cuts staff
items.summary: Wall Street analysts rushed to Celldex’s defense following the setback. Elsewhere, Isomorphic Labs cut a cancer-focused deal with Merck and Teva’s research chief accepted a new job.

items.title: This week in charts: Biotech investors’ China bets are already paying off
items.summary: This year, companies built around medicines from China have sped toward acquisitions or IPOs. Meanwhile, Summit is no longer the Wall Street darling it was in 2024.

items.title: Study raises doubts about combining vaccine, monoclonal antibody to protect against malaria
items.summary: A monoclonal antibody holds promise in preventing malaria, but researchers found it interfered with a new vaccine when used in babies.

items.title: Pfizer leaps into ‘體內實驗’ CAR-T細胞療法 with latest China deal
items.summary: The potentially $2.6 billion collaboration puts Pfizer into a competitive race to treat autoimmune conditions by reprogramming cells inside the body.

items.title: Aspen Neuroscience 申請 1.345 億美元首次公開募股 (IPO)
items.summary: 生技公司 Aspen Neuroscience 申請首次公開募股 (IPO)，目標募資 1.345 億美元，將投入神經退化性疾病的細胞療法開發。
